visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: parseInt Receives the Index as Its Radix
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Converting the strings 1, 2 and 3 should give [1,2,3], but the program prints [1,null,null].

solution.explanation: map calls parseInt(value, index, array), so the index is used as the radix: parseInt("2", 1) is NaN because radix 1 is invalid. Wrap the call in a function that passes only the value and an explicit radix of 10.
